findingsAndFixes: Normal FINISHED deadline incorrectly matched short control deadline. It now includes known offered PCM duration; STOP does not.
Expiry/session exception used to close socket before STOP. Work cancellation and output close now precede transport closure; expiry during active playback with delayed STOPPED tested.
Known retired-device receipts are discarded without satisfying current requests, with a budget of eight. Unknown nonces still fail.
Pinned Espressif1.7.0 followed redirects internally, bypassing endpoint freeze. Optional disable_redirect rejects before URI change; enabled for Eva only.

One compile used a relative source path pointing to the earlier auth copy. That compile was explicitly terminated; fixed source generation and local patched dependency were verified before replacement build.
The old build cache continued to reference the former managed archive after selecting the local component. Final build uses a fresh workspace and matching local component name.

ESP-IDF transport_ws logs complete upgrade headers even on failed writes. The two WebSocket transport/client log tags are disabled before authenticated I/O, with dynamic tag-level control enabled in the generated firmware. This reduces diagnostic output for those tags device-wide.
limitations: No firmware flashed, installed endpoint, live device credential or real physical TLS handshake.
Session callback still needs continuous microphone/wake/mute integration and native household conversation composition.
Known-nonce history is process-local; firmware send/reset failure paths and physical reconnect still require validation.
Voice hears-context preservation, physical recovery, acoustic interruption and p95 still open.
Temporary TLS test credentials/certificates only; no household audio or model request sent by these probes.
